ack_loss_recovery.recovery_rule: Ignore acknowledgement for safety reasoning; perform a fresh role-local LATEST read before any replay. If this deterministic_effect_key is present, classify committed and suppress replay. If key is absent and predecessor remains current, permit one CAS-guarded replay. Divergent successor without key is conflict and blocks replay.
ack_loss_recovery.uncommitted_world: modeled state-machine branch only; no transport fault injection capability used

mechanism_assessment.tested_limit: Live committed/readback branch for one role-local pointer plus formal uncommitted branch; no concurrent writer, network fault injection, or divergent-successor execution in this slice.

exact_next_action: On the next valid invocation, execute exactly one divergent-successor recovery probe: starting from a fresh role-local LATEST read that represents an unrelated successor without the pending effect key, prove the recovery rule never overwrites that successor and never replays the stale effect blindly. Define one conflict-safe child transition (abort-and-rederive or successor-relative rebase) using only role-local CAS/readback, test its at-most-once property in the smallest deterministic model, persist/read back, and stop without a second leaf.
